source_text: Adverse events from neonatal circumcision occur in approximately 0.2-0.6% of cases, predominantly minor and resolvable, while pain is substantially alleviated through established protocols like dorsal penile nerve block with lidocaine, which studies show markedly reduces neonatal distress compared to no intervention. [60]
